title: 専門ゼミ(経営情報学科)
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III(Management Systems)
keywords: Design Project III 2.Design Project 3.Project Proposal 4.Research Methods 5.Community Oriented
educationalGoal: The aim of this class is to prepare students for Design Project III in each of the research laboratories. In this course, students will: (1) determine their theme for Design Project III. (2) survey topics and articles related to their Design Project III theme (3) prepare activities/tools that will be involved in Design Project III, including devices, software, experimental methods, social inquiries, and so on.
advice: This is a required course for juniors. It is designed to prepare students for Design Project III in the fourth year. Department supervisors will conduct the course, providing instruction and advice in seminar style. The basic course plan is as follows: 1) Setting a theme and goal for Design Project III. 2) Devising an action plan to accomplish the defined goal. 3) Surveying related research. 4) Creating project proposal documents for each Design Project III activity. Students are expected to observe the department presentations by fourth-year Design Project III students at the end of the semester. The experience of attending these oral presentations will be of great help to students who will be engaged in Design Project III activities in the following year.
requiredKnowledge: Each supervisor will provide instructions and guidance; students are expected to follow these instructions.

    授業科目の学習・教育目標   キーワード 学習・教育目標     1.Design Project III 2.Design Project 3.Project Proposal 4.Research Methods 5.Community Oriented  The aim of this class is to prepare students for Design Project III in each of the research laboratories. In this course, students will: (1) determine their theme for Design Project III. (2) survey topics and articles related to their Design Project III theme (3) prepare activities/tools that will be involved in Design Project III, including devices, software, experimental methods, social inquiries, and so on.
    授業の概要および学習上の助言   This is a required course for juniors. It is designed to prepare students for Design Project III in the fourth year. Department supervisors will conduct the course, providing instruction and advice in seminar style. The basic course plan is as follows: 1) Setting a theme and goal for Design Project III. 2) Devising an action plan to accomplish the defined goal. 3) Surveying related research. 4) Creating project proposal documents for each Design Project III activity. Students are expected to observe the department presentations by fourth-year Design Project III students at the end of the semester. The experience of attending these oral presentations will be of great help to students who will be engaged in Design Project III activities in the following year.
